value.value: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `domus_ai`.`vw_alertas_ativos` AS select `a`.`id_alerta` AS `id_alerta`,`r`.`nome` AS `residencia`,`a`.`data_hora` AS `data_hora`,`a`.`tipo` AS `tipo`,`a`.`titulo` AS `titulo`,`a`.`mensagem` AS `mensagem`,`a`.`severidade` AS `severidade`,`a`.`status` AS `status` from (`domus_ai`.`alertas` `a` join `domus_ai`.`residencias` `r` on((`a`.`id_residencia` = `r`.`id_residencia`))) where (`a`.`status` in ('NAO_LIDO','LIDO','EM_ANALISE'))

CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `domus_ai`.`vw_consumo_agua` AS select `r`.`id_residencia` AS `id_residencia`,`r`.`nome` AS `residencia`,`c`.`nome` AS `comodo`,cast(`m`.`data_hora` as date) AS `data`,sum(`m`.`valor`) AS `consumo_litros` from ((((`domus_ai`.`medicoes` `m` join `domus_ai`.`sensores` `s` on((`m`.`id_sensor` = `s`.`id_sensor`))) join `domus_ai`.`tipos_sensor` `ts` on((`s`.`id_tipo_sensor` = `ts`.`id_tipo_sensor`))) join `domus_ai`.`comodos` `c` on((`s`.`id_comodo` = `c`.`id_comodo`))) join `domus_ai`.`residencias` `r` on((`c`.`id_residencia` = `r`.`id_residencia`))) where ((`ts`.`categoria` = 'AGUA') and (`m`.`qualidade_dado` = 'VALIDO')) group by `r`.`id_residencia`,`r`.`nome`,`c`.`nome`,cast(`m`.`data_hora` as date)

CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `domus_ai`.`vw_consumo_energia` AS select `r`.`id_residencia` AS `id_residencia`,`r`.`nome` AS `residencia`,`c`.`nome` AS `comodo`,`d`.`nome` AS `dispositivo`,cast(`m`.`data_hora` as date) AS `data`,sum(`m`.`valor`) AS `consumo_kwh` from (((((`domus_ai`.`medicoes` `m` join `domus_ai`.`sensores` `s` on((`m`.`id_sensor` = `s`.`id_sensor`))) join `domus_ai`.`tipos_sensor` `ts` on((`s`.`id_tipo_sensor` = `ts`.`id_tipo_sensor`))) join `domus_ai`.`comodos` `c` on((`s`.`id_comodo` = `c`.`id_comodo`))) join `domus_ai`.`residencias` `r` on((`c`.`id_residencia` = `r`.`id_residencia`))) left join `domus_ai`.`dispositivos` `d` on((`m`.`id_dispositivo` = `d`.`id_dispositivo`))) where ((`ts`.`categoria` = 'ENERGIA') and (`m`.`qualidade_dado` = 'VALIDO')) group by `r`.`id_residencia`,`r`.`nome`,`c`.`nome`,`d`.`nome`,cast(`m`.`data_hora` as date)

CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `domus_ai`.`vw_domus_dashboard` AS select `r`.`id_residencia` AS `id_residencia`,`r`.`nome` AS `residencia`,(select `ds`.`score_total` from `domus_ai`.`domus_scores` `ds` where (`ds`.`id_residencia` = `r`.`id_residencia`) order by `ds`.`data_referencia` desc limit 1) AS `domus_score`,(select count(0) from `domus_ai`.`alertas` `a` where ((`a`.`id_residencia` = `r`.`id_residencia`) and (`a`.`status` = 'NAO_LIDO'))) AS `alertas_nao_lidos`,(select count(0) from `domus_ai`.`anomalias` `an` where ((`an`.`id_residencia` = `r`.`id_residencia`) and (`an`.`status` = 'ABERTA'))) AS `anomalias_abertas`,(select count(0) from (`domus_ai`.`dispositivos` `d` join `domus_ai`.`comodos` `c` on((`d`.`id_comodo` = `c`.`id_comodo`))) where ((`c`.`id_residencia` = `r`.`id_residencia`) and (`d`.`estado` = 'LIGADO'))) AS `dispositivos_ligados` from `domus_ai`.`residencias` `r`
